headline: OpenAI releases GPT 5.6 Cyber amid rising healthcare security demands
body: OpenAI has released GPT 5.6 Cyber, a model variant designed with cybersecurity capabilities as the threat landscape for healthcare systems intensifies. The release comes as healthcare organizations face mounting pressure to defend EHRs and clinical data pipelines against sophisticated attacks. For healthcare AI deployments, this capability matters directly: secure language models reduce compliance friction in HIPAA-regulated environments and strengthen confidence in AI-assisted clinical workflows. Healthcare vendors and health systems evaluating large language models for documentation, coding, and clinical decision support should assess whether Cyber-class models better mitigate their specific threat vectors compared to standard variants.
